segments.t: I'm a public company CEO and every so often
someone asks me a question and most of the time,
most of the time, well some of the time,
I'm gonna try to lower the bar here,
some of the time I say something right.
And sometimes it comes out wrong.
And so what happened was somebody asked me
how long before a quantum computer will be useful.
And remember, this is from somebody
who's built a computing platform.
And to me, building NVIDIA and building CUDA
and turning it into the computing platform that it is today,
it has taken us almost, well it's taken us over 20 years.
So the idea that time horizons of five, 10, 15, 20 years
is really nothing to me.
And of course quantum computing has the potential,
has the potential and the hope, all of our hopes,
that it will deliver extraordinary impact.
But the technology is insanely complicated.
And so the idea that it would take years to achieve
was something that, one, I would expect.
